envelope.description: Add PATH_FORM_RULE and describe the path-valued schema fields with it

body.title: Add PATH_FORM_RULE and describe the path-valued schema fields with it
body.summary: Add the PATH_FORM_RULE string constant to src/workflow/runners/scope-prompts.ts, stating the form (project file relative to the root, optional :N, :N-M or :N:C and #anchor, no prose in the span, never shortened; external file written in full; a path copied from a step output that is not in this form is corrected rather than copied). Add a description carrying that wording to the callSites and pathsCited fields in the design-story, define, design-epic and plan schemas, without adding a pattern.
acceptanceChecks: PATH_FORM_RULE is exported from src/workflow/runners/scope-prompts.ts and nowhere else defines the wording
The callSites field in the design-story schema and the pathsCited field in the design-story, define, design-epic and plan schemas have a description that carries the rule wording
No schema gains a pattern or a new required field, and the existing schema tests still pass

tests.name: src/workflow/__tests__/path-forms.test.ts: the callSites and pathsCited schema descriptions carry the rule wording
